product_description: Other insecticides, rodenticides, fungicides, herbicides, sprout inhibitors and plant growth regulators, disinfectants and similar products, in the form of a brown, viscous liquid; the product is used – according to the company – as a seed dressing for bird deterrence in maize; packaged in 1000 L IBCs.
A plastic music stand that can be attached to a digital piano using an adapter. The adapter is not part of this BTI. Dimensions: 50 cm x 21.5 cm x 4.8 cm.

According to the declared data, these are products (upper and lower vibration dampers) made of nitrile-butadiene rubber (NBR). The products are intended to dampen the transmission of vibrations in the handle of a hammer drill.

According to the declared data, this is a broken natural stone (marble, sandstone, lava stone), which is only cleaned of mechanical impurities. The product is suitable for use in aquariums, terrariums, gardens and ponds.

Circuit board with holder for battery-powered pole pruners - a product manufactured specifically according to a technical drawing, essentially consisting of a central carrier structure for electronic components (circuit board) equipped with two inductors (coils) and four capacitors, as well as an integrated plastic spacer, - designed as a permanently installed, device-specific, and functionally necessary assembly for battery-powered pole pruners, - for installation (mounting) in handheld battery-operated tools with an integrated electric motor (battery-powered pole pruners), - for use as a passive functional component for radio interference suppression of the device-specific electric motor of a battery-powered pole pruner and as a spacer. "Part identifiable as being intended exclusively or principally for handheld tools with an integrated electric motor, not for chainsaws or pneumatic tools, not a product of code number 8467 9900 10 0 - Circuit board with holder for battery-powered pole pruners"

Thallium iodide: According to the information provided, the product is chemically pure thallium iodide. It is a yellow solid. The CAS number is 7790-30-9. The product is used as a doping agent in scintillation applications. It is classified under TARIC code 2827 6000 90 as chlorides, chloride oxides and chloride hydroxides; bromides and bromide oxides; iodides and iodide oxides; iodides and iodide oxides, other.

Details: Spare part for swimming pool pump, plastic stepped outlet fitting. No sample was submitted. Based on a submitted photograph, the product appears to be a black connector in the form of a stepped fitting. Findings: Connectors, made of plastic, other, other

Applicant's information: SunSun spare part outlet assembly HW-504A/505A, intended as a component or spare part for an aquarium filter system or aquatics application, intended for installation or use within a technical system, not a standalone device, but a part/accessory. A product sample was not submitted. The goods were illustrated by photographs and described by a data sheet. According to this, it is a plastic connection assembly. The three PVC pipe sections (two straight and one curved) are rigid and are supplied together with plastic connectors/fittings (a hose clamp, a plastic screw, an outlet, two connecting sleeves, and a spray tube end cap) and a rubber suction cup. Findings: The characteristic features of these are rigid plastic pipes made of vinyl chloride polymers.

Applicant's description: Stickers used during the edging of spectacle lenses to prevent the lens from twisting in the grinding machine. Transparent, individually peelable stickers made of plastic (polyethylene with polyester coating). The stickers are rolled onto a backing paper in a printed cardboard box. Findings on a sample: Oval, transparent, self-adhesive flat products were submitted on a protective paper backing, each with a hole in the center. Identification: Self-adhesive flat products made of plastic.

Stainless steel tubes. The goods are square stainless steel tubes (304) with a uniform square cross-section along their entire length, with an edge length of 25 mm. The tube is 280 mm long and has a hole at each end on one side. The goods are manufactured by welding. The goods are used as a base for IV stands. The goods are to be classified under subheading 7306 6110 of the Combined Nomenclature as other tubes and hollow sections (e.g., welded, riveted, folded or with simply butted edges), of iron or steel, other, welded, of non-circular cross-section, of square or rectangular cross-section, of stainless steel.

Application details: Citrus fiber, produced from depectinized citrus pomace, in the form of a fine, cream-colored powder with a neutral odor and taste and very high swelling capacity. The residue from pectin production is washed with water and alcohol. The product is then dried and ground. The product is suitable for human consumption and is used, among other things, for dietary fiber enrichment. It could also be used as a supplementary feed for animals. Plant materials and plant waste, plant residues and plant by-products of the type used for feeding, also in the form of pellets, not elsewhere specified or included, pomace (excluding grape pomace).

Pipe connector. The goods are a tubular section made of stainless steel (1.4404). According to the specifications, this section is cut at a right angle from a welded tube with a circular cross-section by simply cutting it to length without any further processing (deburring, chamfering). The outside diameter is 114.3 mm with a wall thickness of 2.6 mm, and the length (cut length) is 122 mm. The pipe section is used to manufacture fittings, specifically concentric reducers for butt welding. In its current state, the pipe section is already suitable for butt welding. The goods are to be classified as "Pipe connectors, other, of stainless steel, connectors for butt welding, other" under subheading 7307 2390 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Copper strip. The goods are a strip of refined copper with a thickness of less than 0.15 mm, a width of 12.5 mm, and a length of 100 m. The strip is traded in coils. The strip is laminated with plastic. The goods are used as flat copper wire for induction loops. The goods are to be classified as foils and thin strips of copper (whether printed or on paper, cardboard, plastic, or similar substrates), with a thickness (excluding the backing) of 0.15 mm or less, on a backing, of refined copper, other, under tariff code 7410 2100 90.

Potassium nitrate. The product is chemically pure potassium nitrate (molecular formula KNO3). It is a colorless to white prilled solid. The CAS number is 7757-79-1. The product is to be classified as nitrites; nitrates, nitrates, of potassium, under TARIC code 2834 2100 00.

Applicant's description: Semi-transparent, flexible, approximately 5 cm wide, cloudy, stretchable, non-adhesive film made of ethylene-propylene copolymer for laboratory use. Polyethylene content predominates. The film is approximately 0.14 mm thick and covered with a protective film. No sample was submitted. Findings: Other sheets, plates, films, foils, tapes, and strips, not of cellular plastics, neither reinforced nor laminated or similarly bonded to other materials, without a backing; of ethylene polymers; with a thickness greater than 0.125 mm; other; other; other

Applicant's information: Dextrin powder. Findings/investigations on a sample: White, flour-fine powder. The powder is soluble in water; no starch is visible microscopically. The measured DE value is approximately 7.6% by weight (based on the dry matter). Finding: Dextrins with a dextrose equivalent of less than or equal to 10%.

Germanium tetrafluoride, enriched with germanium-72. The product is characterized as a colorless gas. According to the information provided, it is germanium tetrafluoride with a purity of 99.9% by volume or more, enriched with the germanium isotope 72Ge to a content of 50 to 53 at% or 55 to 58 at%. The product is used for semiconductor manufacturing. Based on its chemical composition, the product is to be classified under subheading 2845 9090 of the Combined Nomenclature as isotopes (excluding isotopes of heading 2844); inorganic or organic compounds of these isotopes, even if not chemically homogeneous; other; other.

A toy in the form of a dinosaur construction kit – made of plastic, assembled with dimensions of approximately 7 x 5 x 4.5 cm – consisting of eight parts, some of which are painted – the components are designed to fit together and are not suitable for playing with on their own – includes illustrated instructions, the back of which shows all available dinosaurs in the series – intended for children's entertainment – ​​the parts are packaged in a bag containing slime (DEBTI-22639/26-2) and two stickers (DEBTI-22639/26-3), inside a plastic egg with a protruding bone, for individual sale. All components are classified separately because the goods do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to perform a particular activity and therefore do not constitute a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b). Classification as a combination within the meaning of Note 4 to Chapter 95 is also not possible due to the mass of the slime and the size of the stickers compared to the size of the construction kit. Therefore, all components must be classified separately. For customs tariff purposes, the goods are classified as "toys, kits, made of plastic other than those covered by subheadings (CN) 9503 0010 to 9503 0030".

The goods in question are slime in the form of a moist, slightly sticky, greenish, and non-stable mass. It is intended to elicit disgust or shock upon viewing or touching. The slime is packaged in a printed plastic bag containing parts of a dinosaur model kit (DEBTI-22639/26-1). The slime, along with the model kit, instructions, and two stickers (DEBTI-22639/26-3), is packaged together in a plastic egg with a protruding bone and a plastic band for individual sale. All components are classified separately because the goods do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to carry out a particular activity and therefore do not constitute a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b). Classification as a combination within the meaning of Note 4 to Chapter 95 is also not possible due to the mass of the slime and the size of the stickers compared to the size of the model kit. Therefore, all components must be classified separately. For customs tariff purposes, the goods are classified as "entertainment articles, other than Christmas articles".

The goods in question are an incomplete brush. The product consists of a beechwood handle (according to the applicant) with curved plastic bristles as the insert material, depending on the model, 35 cm, 45 cm, or 65 cm wide. A fitting for a handle is located at the top (not the subject of the binding tariff information decision). The goods possess the essential characteristics of a brush and are intended for household cleaning. The product is to be classified as "brush, other than those covered by subheadings (CN) 9603 1000 to 9603 9010, brushes for household cleaning".

Stainless steel cable with threaded ends. The goods are a 900 mm long, flexible, plastic-coated stainless steel cable with a diameter of 1.5 mm (2.0 mm including the coating). Brass end pieces with M4 threads for attaching brushes are fitted to both ends of the cable. The stainless steel cable is a defining characteristic. The goods are used for cleaning pipes. The goods are to be classified under TARIC code 7312 9000 00 as rope loops and similar articles of iron or steel, excluding insulated electrical products, other.

Applicant's information: Chocolate bar from the article "Christmas Felt Stocking". Confidential information is available regarding the composition. Findings on samples: Milk chocolate bar (dimensions: approx. 5.5 x 2.5 x 1.5 cm), filled with a beige, creamy mass; odor: chocolate; taste: sweet, chocolate and milk cream. The bar is wrapped in brightly printed plastic film (labeling (excerpt): "choco & cream"). Finding: Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations: other, in the form of bars, sticks or tablets: filled. The goods are packaged together with other confectionery in a polybag, which is placed inside a Christmas stocking (DEBTI-24237/26-1) (see DEBTI-24237/26-2 and -3). Joint classification as a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b) is not possible due to the lack of common demand.

Refined copper rod. According to the description, the goods are a blow-clad rod made of refined copper (Cu-HCO₃) and aluminum (Al1050). The rod has a width of 31 mm and a total thickness of 20 mm. The copper layer is 8 mm thick, and the aluminum layer is 12 mm thick. The length is 52 mm. The aluminum layer has a chamfer on both sides. The goods are used as a contact plate for the cathode system in zinc electrolysis. The copper content is predominant by weight. Based on its material composition, the goods are classified as rods and profiles of copper, of refined copper, under TARIC code 7407 1000 00.

The goods described as a "storage box" are wooden furniture with dimensions (W x H x D) of 35 x 120 x 25 cm, essentially consisting of an approximately cuboid body with a small base plate at the top and bottom, a back panel at the top and bottom, and five parallel, upward-curving, and rounded recesses on the completely open front, designed to hold stools. The product, intended for floor placement, is used to furnish kindergartens or schools for storing student stools. The goods are classified as "furniture of wood other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402, without a specific spatial connection." Attachment: Illustration

Applicant's description: Polyurethane film without reinforcement with other materials or cellular structure. The film has the following structure: 1) Self-adhesive polyester carrier 2) Colored glass beads embedded in polyurethane-polyester hot melt 3) Polyurethane protective film. Findings on a sample: Two rectangular sections of a gray film with glass beads embedded on one side were submitted (thickness approx. 0.185 mm). The film is covered with colorless, transparent, peelable films on both sides. The protective film on the side with the embedded glass beads is self-adhesive. Conclusion: This is a plastic film (here polyester urethane) without reinforcement. The protective films and the glass beads do not affect the classification.

Applicant's description: A light yellow film/flat product made of cellular plastic (polyurethane foam). Non-adhesive and contains no abrasives. Findings on a sample: A rectangular section (approx. 210 x 160 mm; approx. 1.3 mm thick) of an ochre-colored film made of a cellular material was submitted. Conclusion: It is a different film, made of plastics, cellular plastic, polyurethane, or soft foam.

Applicant's information: Resistant dextrin powder. White to light yellow, fine powder obtained from tapioca starch. DE equivalent < 10. Findings on a sample: White, flour-fine powder. The powder is soluble in water; no starch type is discernible microscopically. The measured DE value is approximately 8.1% by weight (based on the dry matter). Finding: Dextrins with a dextrose equivalent of less than or equal to 10%.

Applicant's information: The compressed air hose with a wall thickness of 3 mm is pressure-resistant up to 15 bar. The compressor hose also contains a fabric reinforcement, which gives the polyvinyl chloride hose additional stability and extends its service life. The air hose has a standard quick-release coupling including a hose barb, which is compatible with all common devices and machines. Length: 10, 15, or 30 meters (depending on selection). Outer diameter: 12 mm. Inner diameter: 6 mm. Connection: 1/4". Wall thickness: 3 mm. Material: Plastic; copper-plated steel. A product sample was not submitted. The light blue hose was illustrated by photographs. These also show that the flexible hose has connectors. Finding: This is a different flexible, reinforced plastic hose that cannot withstand a pressure of 27.6 MPa.

A board-to-cable connector for mounting on a printed circuit board, essentially consisting of an approximately cuboid-shaped plastic housing measuring 37 x 15 x 4 mm, with 51 internal contact pins on one side and the corresponding number of solder pins angled at 90° on the other. The product is designed for a voltage of less than 1000 V and serves to connect electrical circuits after insertion of a corresponding mating contact and mounting on a printed circuit board. The product is classified as "electrical device for connecting electrical circuits, for a voltage of less than 1000 V, connector for printed circuits". Attachment: 1 Figure

Applicant's description: A ready-made, ready-to-use yoga/gymnastics mat, manufactured and placed on the market exclusively for the practice of yoga, Pilates, and general physical exercise. The product consists of five firmly bonded layers: The top layer is a 0.4 mm thick layer of cork granules (175 g), which serves as the exercise surface for grip and skin contact. This is followed by a layer of solvent-free polyurethane adhesive (25 g) to bond the layers. The middle layer consists of a 0.1 mm thick polyester fabric (50 g), which provides reinforcement and dimensional stability. A further layer of EVA hot melt adhesive (25 g) bonds the middle layer to the bottom layer. This bottom layer consists of vulcanized natural rubber, black, with a thickness of 3.5 mm and a weight of 2,025 g; it forms the non-slip surface of the mat. The mat weighs approximately 2,300 g with a total thickness of approximately 4 mm and dimensions of 1,830 × 610 mm. Findings on a sample: A multi-layered mat with rounded corners was presented. The mat consists of a thick, cellular, elastic, black base layer and a thin cork top layer. A textile material is sandwiched between the layers. The mat is rolled up and equipped with a carrying strap. Findings: Other goods made of soft rubber, cellular rubber, other

Applicant's information: Resistant dextrin powder from tapioca starch. White or slightly yellowish powder. DE equivalent < 10. Findings/investigations on a sample: White, flour-fine powder. The powder is soluble in water; no starch type is discernible microscopically. The measured DE value is approximately 7.8% by weight (based on the dry matter). Finding: Dextrins with a dextrose equivalent of less than or equal to 10%.

Applicant's information: Resistant dextrin powder. White to slightly yellow powder derived from corn starch. DE equivalent < 10. Findings on a sample: White, flour-fine powder. The powder is soluble in water; no starch type is discernible microscopically. The measured DE value is approximately 7.1% by weight (based on the dry matter). Finding: Dextrins with a dextrose equivalent of less than or equal to 10%.

Applicant's information: The goods are films made of PVC (plasticizer-free) and used for primary packaging in the food and pharmaceutical industries. The single-layer mono-films have varying thicknesses (60–500 µm) and colors. Findings: The products are plastic films made of vinyl chloride polymers with a thickness of 1 mm or less.

Applicant's details: A Santa Claus Christmas tin made of tinplate. It contains a hollow chocolate Santa Claus figure, three chocolate pralines with milk cream filling, and three chocolate pralines with praline cream filling. Confidential information is available regarding the composition. Findings on samples: Hollow milk chocolate figure in the shape of Santa Claus (height: approx. 7.5 cm); odor: chocolate; taste: sweet, milk chocolate. The hollow figure is wrapped in brightly printed metal foil. The hollow chocolate figure is contained, together with six pralines (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-29286/26-2), in a metal tin (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-29286/26-1). This binding tariff information decision relates exclusively to the hollow chocolate figure from the assortment. Finding: Chocolate and other food preparations containing cocoa: other: Chocolate and chocolate products: other: unfilled

Human blood for diagnostic analysis. According to the applicant, the goods in question are samples of human blood used for diagnostic and analytical purposes in preparation for a hematopoietic stem cell transplant. The samples are used to carry out essential immunological and hematological tests to ensure compatibility between donor and recipient and the safety of the transplantation process. This includes, in particular, HLA (Human Leukocyte Antigen) typing, blood group determination, crossmatching to test compatibility, and screening for infectious diseases. The samples are provided in small volumes in special medical collection tubes (e.g., containing anticoagulants such as EDTA or heparin) and are refrigerated or transported at controlled temperatures to maintain cellular integrity for laboratory analysis. The goods are to be classified as human blood under subheading 3002 9010 of the Customs Tariff.

Esters of acetic acid; geranyl acetate. According to the information provided, the product is a mixture of isomers of geranyl acetate and neryl acetate. A synonymous name is 3,7-dimethyl-2,6-octadien-1-ol acetate. The CAS number is 105-87-3. The purity is at least 98%. The product is a colorless to yellowish, oily liquid. The product is to be classified as another ester of acetic acid under subheading 2915 3900 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Intermediate gear, made of a cylindrical, stepped plastic body (Durethan), consisting of three consecutive gears, with the following dimensions: overall: diameter 90 mm, height 40 mm; outer gear: diameter 90 mm, height 10 mm, 69 teeth; middle gear: diameter 40 mm, height 18 mm, 16 teeth; inner gear: diameter 22 mm, height 12 mm, 8 teeth; central bore: diameter 10 mm. When installed in an electromechanical actuator, it is used to open and close flap systems by means of motion transmission. "Gear, separately supplied, not cast from iron or steel."

The product in question is a driveshaft, also known as a "profile tube for driveshafts," as illustrated in the attachment. It is a combined unit consisting essentially of two couplings mounted on either side of a driveshaft. The driveshaft, available in various designs, comprises an inner profile tube and an outer profile tube that are inserted into one another. Lengths vary between 0.5 m and 3 m. The product's primary function is to transmit rotational forces between a tractor and a coupled trailer. "Driveshafts, not for civil aircraft"

Moringa extract. White powder, purified extract of the seeds of Moringa oleifera, intended for use in the food industry. Starch/Glucose*: 50 to less than 75% by weight. Sucrose/Invert sugar/Isoglucose**: less than 5% by weight. Milk fat, milk protein: not included according to the recipe. *: Application information: Food preparation, not elsewhere specified or included, containing 5% or more by weight of glucose or starch, not containing milk fat, with a sucrose (including invert sugar calculated as sucrose) or isoglucose (calculated as sucrose) content of less than 60% by weight.

Applicant's information: Mixture of cocoa-containing and non-cocoa-containing sugar sprinkles. Confidential information regarding the composition is available. Packaging: 30 kg paper bags. A product sample was not submitted. Finding: Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations: other preparations in blocks, bars or sticks weighing more than 2 kg or in liquid, paste, powder, granule or similar form, in containers or immediate packings with a content exceeding 2 kg: other: other

According to the application and the submitted sample, the so-called "Decorative Shelf Sitter Angel" is a stylized angel figure in two color versions, consisting of a conical torso with an attached head, hands, and feet made of a foamed plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. The decorative item has a painted face and is equipped with movable arms and legs, as well as a "dress" and a hat made of textiles. The item has permanently attached textile wings on its back and a hanging loop on its top. Due to the objective nature and design of the item (designed as a shelf sitter, with a flattened body and excessively long legs), classification as a festive item or Christmas tree ornament under heading 9505 is not possible. Furthermore, it is not a doll as defined in heading 9503 (as an angel, it is not a human representation). Particularly with regard to its significance in terms of use, the plastic is considered to be a character-giving element. Such products are classified under customs tariff law as "other goods made of plastic, statuettes and other ornamental articles".

According to the applicant's information and the submitted samples, the products are unprinted cardboard folding boxes (sample packaging), each containing twenty tobacco sticks approximately 4.8 cm long. The sticks have the following structure (from the burning end to the mouthpiece): a slightly moist strand of cut, brown material, apparently tobacco foil (reconstituted tobacco); a non-woven, tube-like filter element; a section of accordion-folded paper; a non-woven filter piece; and are wrapped in white cigarette paper printed with two bronze-colored stripes and a brand name. The sticks, available in three different flavors, are intended to be heated in a special electric vaporizer, with the resulting vapor being inhaled (non-combustion inhalation). For customs tariff purposes, such goods are to be classified as "products for non-combustion inhalation containing tobacco or reconstituted tobacco."

According to the applicant's information and the available illustrations, the product is a rectangular woven material made from dried heather shoots (wickerwork within the meaning of Note 1 to Chapter 46), arranged parallel to one another and bound together in mat form with binding material (thin metal wires). The product, manufactured in two sizes, is primarily intended for use as frost protection for planters and pots. Such goods are classified under the customs tariff as "wickerwork, joined parallel to one another in sheet form, even if it thereby acquires the character of finished goods (e.g., mats, straw mats, latticework), of plant materials other than bamboo or rattan, not of wickerwork or similar articles of wickerwork."

According to the applicant's information and the submitted technical drawing, the item in question is a munition component in the form of an unfilled (without explosives or propellant), specifically shaped artillery shell casing. The 584.2 mm long casing is made of steel and has an outer diameter of 152.1 mm. A copper driving band, "standard" for artillery shells, is rolled onto the steel body of the casing. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as a munition component for grenades, for military purposes.

These are specifically shaped products manufactured according to technical drawings from a nickel-chromium alloy with nickel being the predominant component by weight (Inconel 625 – according to the applicant). The disc-shaped products have several through holes and a groove on the outer surface. Produced by turning, these products are used to manufacture glass-to-metal inlets for the insulated passage of electrical conductors through a hermetically sealed housing. Such products are classified as "other nickel goods (than those specified in code 7508 1000 00 0)" under tariff heading 7508 9000 00 0.

"Shaped parts" made of a gold alloy: The goods are flat shaped parts made of a gold-tin alloy (80% gold, 20% tin) in various sizes and shapes, specifically: round rings and discs, rectangular rings with rounded and angular corners, and square plates. The goods are used in soldering processes in the electronics sector. - Applicant's information - Such products are classified as "gold as semi-finished products (other than those specified in code numbers 7108 1100 00 0 to 7308 1380 00 1)" under tariff code 7308 1380 00 9.

Natural, also synthetically produced alkaloid; caffeine. According to the submitted data sheets, the product is the chemically homogeneous compound caffeine. Synonymous names are 1,3,7-trimethylxanthine and theine. The purity is at least 99%. The CAS number is 58-08-2. The product is a white powder. It is to be classified as caffeine, a natural, also synthetically produced alkaloid, under subheading 2939 3000 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Doll – depicting a bearded man – approximately 31 cm tall – sewn together from various fabrics – with a plastic skeleton; the arms and head are filled with soft material; the torso consists of a plastic casing with a motor and sound module; the battery compartments are located in the feet; dressed in jeans with leg pockets, a red hoodie, and black and white shoes; with black plastic eyes, a white beard with a mustache and mouth; the doll wears a red baseball cap and black plastic sunglasses; on its right hand, it has an on/off switch; when the switch is pressed, the doll moves to Christmas hip-hop music; intended for playful entertainment. The doll holds a clear bag, attached to it with a ribbon, containing five chocolate pralines and a chocolate bar. This binding tariff information (BTI) decision relates exclusively to the musical figure (Santa Claus) from the set with chocolate pralines (see DEBTI-40865/26-1) and a chocolate bar (see DEBTI-40865/26-3). For customs tariff purposes, the goods are classified as a "doll representing a human being".

Details: A plush toy made of polyester and a cardboard bag. The cardboard bag contains, in addition to the plush toy, four chocolate pralines with a milk cream filling, two chocolate bars, and a pack of gummy candies. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings based on a sample: Four individually wrapped, oblong, brown chocolate pralines (dimensions in cm: approx. 3.5 x 2 x 1.5) with a chocolate-like odor, each wrapped in red composite foil (printed with "milk cream"), filled with a light beige cream. The chocolate pralines are packaged together with a plush toy (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-40868/26-2), a pack of gummy candies (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-40868/26-3), and two chocolate bars (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-40868/26-4) in a cardboard folding box printed with a Christmas motif (dimensions in cm: approx. 27 x 14 x 9) with a handle and a cutout for the plush toy's head. Labeling (excerpt): "Merry Christmas". This binding tariff information decision relates exclusively to the chocolate pralines included in the package with the plush toy, two chocolate bars, and a pack of gummy candies. Finding: Chocolate and other food preparations containing cocoa: other: Chocolate and chocolate products: Pralines, also filled: other.

Applicant's information: Crude sunflower oil with a high linoleic acid content. Production: Pressing and extraction. Use: Suitable for use as food. Botanical origin: Heliantus annuus L. Findings on a sample: Yellow, slightly cloudy, oily liquid; odor: characteristic of sunflower oil. Indication: Sunflower oil, safflower oil, and cottonseed oil, as well as their fractions, including refined but not chemically modified: Sunflower oil and safflower oil, as well as their fractions: crude oils: other: sunflower oil

Other confectionery without cocoa content; sugar sprinkles. The goods are elongated sprinkles of sugar in various colors. They are used, for example, to decorate baked goods. The goods are to be classified as other confectionery without cocoa content, dragees, under subheading 1704 9061 of the Combined Nomenclature.

According to the applicant, the product is intended for use as a cat snack (pet food). It consists of freeze-dried chicken breast meat cut into approximately cube-shaped pieces, without any other additives. The product is labelled as a supplementary feed for cats and packaged for individual sale in cylindrical, so-called maxi-tubes (container with a colorfully printed label and plastic lid; contents 200g). Since the production and transport of the product do not comply with food hygiene standards, the product is not suitable for human consumption. Under customs tariff regulations, it is classified as "goods of animal origin, not elsewhere specified or included, unsuitable for human consumption, not covered by TARIC codes 0511 1000 00 to 0511 9985 20".

Stainless steel profile. The product is an L-shaped profile made of stainless steel (1.4301 / AISI 304). The profile has a height of 4.5 mm, 6 mm, 8 mm, 9 mm, 10 mm, 12 mm, 15 mm, 17.5 mm, 20 mm, 25 mm, or 30 mm. The profile has a length of 2500 mm. The product has a brushed or high-gloss polished surface and a regular punched pattern. The product is used as a tile trim. Based on its material composition, the product is classified under TARIC code 7222 4090 90 as bar stock and profiles, stainless steel, profiles, other.

Preparation based on fragrances; strawberry flavouring. According to the applicant, the product in question is a natural flavouring, strawberry type. The light yellow liquid is used in small doses (0.3%) for the production of fruit gums. Confidential information, including details of its composition, is available. The product is to be classified as another preparation based on fragrances, of a type used in the food industry, under subheading 3302 1090 of the Combined Nomenclature.

The product is a facial cleansing foam and appears as a liquid with a mild scent. The product is used to cleanse facial skin and removes dirt, excess sebum and makeup. It is stated that the product (the foam) is applied to wet skin, massaged into the skin with the brush and rinsed away. The product contains, among other things, water, organic surfactants and fragrance. The product is packaged for retail sale. The product is available as a 150 ml bottle with a foam pump with an inclined oval dispenser. The dispenser has a removable, oval and soft silicone brush.

Steel fence post, made of welded round tube (steel Q235), cut to size and further processed. Each post has 4 wire hooks welded to it at a distance of 75, 825, 1475 and 2175 mm from the top of the post, to which the fence wire is attached. Variants: Post 48 – outer diameter 48 mm, wall 1.5 mm, length 3000 mm, weight 5.1 kg; Post 60 – outer diameter 60 mm, wall 2.0 mm, length 3000 mm, weight 8.5 kg. Surface coating: hot-dip galvanizing after manufacture, 420 g/m², EVS-EN 1461. Use: agricultural and game fence posts; installed in the ground and fence netting, clamps and diagonal supports are attached to them.

Nails made from polished steel and obtained by wire drawing. They are presented in 3 kg boxes, not stacked, bundled, or rolled. They have a round, grooved head and the following dimensions: 2 mm in diameter and 35 mm in length, 3 mm in diameter and 70 mm in length, or 4.4 mm in diameter and 100 mm in length.

A rotary incremental optical encoder (sensor) is used to convert the angular position of a shaft into a digital code. Angular motion detection is based on the photoelectric scanning principle, employing a glass disk marked with a series of uniform lines attached to the shaft. A light-emitting unit and a sensor generate an electrical pulse each time a line passes through the disk's field of view as the shaft rotates. The shaft's position is determined by counting the number of pulses relative to the zero mark. This device is used to control angular or linear displacements, when used with racks or lead screws. In combination with an electrical control circuit (not integrated into the encoder and not part of the encoder itself) that counts pulses, it allows for the determination of the angle, position, shaft speed (revolutions per minute), acceleration, and other parameters. The main applications of these rotary transducers are in machine tools, robots, motor systems, and measuring and control equipment. Resolution: up to 5,000 pulses per revolution. Outer diameter: 58 mm. Shaft diameter: 10 mm.
